details: Pfizer never prints Velsipity (etrasimod) revenue on its own line in any earnings release, 10-Q or 10-K from approval (Oct 2023) through the second quarter of 2026. details: Novo Nordisk never prints Esperoct (turoctocog alfa pegol) as its own line. In every quarterly financial report read (31 reports, the Q4 2018 report through the Q2 2026 report, 6-K exhibits caq{q}{yyyy}.htm; the only table rows that name Esperoct are the footnotes 'Comprises ...'), Esperoct is one of the products inside a larger line: 'Haemophilia' / 'Rare blood disorders', whose footnote lists NovoSeven, NovoEight, Esperoct, Refixia, NovoThirteen (and Alhemo from 2024). Running text gives only a country count for Esperoct (e.g. launched in nine countries, FY2019 report) and, from FY2021, a haemophilia A products class total (which, by inference, is NovoEight plus Esperoct, not Esperoct alone); no Esperoct sales figure appears in any table or sentence. No quarterly series can be cited without interpolation or summation across products, so none is staged.
source_quote: Rare blood disorders 6 | 2,896 | (6%) | (4%) | 5,529 ... 6) Comprises NovoSeven, NovoEight, Esperoct, Refixia, NovoThirteen and Alhemo.

details: Odomzo (sonidegib) was approved in July 2015 and sold by Novartis until its divestment to Sun Pharma (Novartis's Q1 2017 report 0001370368-17-000038 cites 'USD 181 million divestment gains (mainly from the divestment of Odomzo)'). Novartis never prints an Odomzo row in any quarterly interim report 2015Q3-2016Q4 (Q3 2015 0001370368-15-000084, Q4 2015 0001370368-16-000098, Q4 2016 above): the Oncology table lists named brands and folds the rest into 'Other'. The 20-F annual reports FY2015 and FY2016 (0001047469-16-009872, 0001047469-17-000338) mention Odomzo only in product and approval lists with no sales figure. Sun Pharma (owner since 2017, not an SEC filer) shows Odomzo in its investor presentations only as a product within the Innovative Medicines total (e.g. the Q1 FY27 earnings deck, 2026-07-31) and does not print a product sales figure; the royalty counterparty Curis (Erivedge) states only that Odomzo sales were first recorded in the US in Q4 2015. No document located prints an Odomzo net sales number.

details: Vizimpro (dacomitinib, approved 2018-09-27) has no row in any Pfizer earnings-release product table (2018-01 to 2026-08, all 35 quarterly earnings-release exhibits 2018-01 to 2026-08 read) and is not named in any of the eight 10-Ks filed 2019-02 to 2026-02 (full text searched) nor in a 10-Q revenue table (the 2019 10-Qs name it only in regulatory-status tables); Pfizer's oncology table names Ibrance, Xtandi, Padcev, Adcetris, Inlyta, Lorbrena, Bosulif, Braftovi/Mektovi, Tukysa, Tivdak and Talzenna and puts the rest in 'All other Oncology'. The quoted rows show where the product would sit; the absence of the name from the tables is the evidence.
